newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 15.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- French communist party leader Robert Hue and predecessor Georges Marchais placed under legal investigation on charges of influence peddling, charges raise party's "indignation".

-- The chairman of German railroad operator Deutsche Bahn, Heinz Durr, says he wants German high-speed trains to reach Paris, while French TGV would reach Berlin and Francfort, to offer best customer service.
-- The secrecy surrounding the merger talks between Franco-British group GEC Alsthom and state-owned nuclear engineering group Framatome are attracting criticism ahead of tomorrow's board meeting.
-- Generale des Eaux to reshuffle public works activity hit by real-estate crisis.

-- Nouvelles Frontieres chairman Jacques Maillot files bid for insolvent airline Air Liberte with support from its main shareholder groupe Rivaud, says he also considers buying airline AOM, up for sale by CDR structure selling off Credit Lyonnais assets.
